title: Ractor Ports and Shareable Procs

content.intro: Learn Ractor Ports and Shareable Procs through a visual model, a minimal Ruby example, and a practical check.
content.why_it_matters: Understanding ractor ports and shareable procs helps you write code that is easier to explain, test, and maintain. It also helps separate Ruby language guarantees from runtime assumptions, dependency behavior, and application-specific rules.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Ractor Ports and Shareable Procs helps you reason about newer ractor communication interfaces. In Ruby, prefer a small example whose inputs and expected result are easy to explain. This lesson connects the syllabus topic to practical code and highlights where assumptions or edge cases matter.

content_blocks.title: How to think about it
content_blocks.text: Begin by identifying the key rule: Newer Ractor communication interfaces. Then connect it to Sharing callable objects. The remaining syllabus points—Version-specific behavior, Testing concurrency constraints—are useful checks before applying this in a larger project.
